title: Conductor product metrics contract, v1
description: The response of GET {baseUrl}?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD. See docs/integrations-product-metrics.md. This file is the source of truth for the shape; the prose explains the meaning.

timezone.description: IANA zone name the days are reckoned in, e.g. America/Los_Angeles.

dataCompleteThrough.description: The last day whose numbers are final. Days after it are stored provisional and re-read.

restatementDays.description: How many days back the backend may still change a number after it has reported it.

reference.description: Optional totals Conductor cross-checks against its own store and ads connectors.

key.description: Stable identifier; lowercase letters, digits and underscores; must not start with ref_.

aggregation.description: SUM adds daily values over a window; LEVEL is a stock whose latest value counts; RATIO is sum(numerator) / sum(denominator) over the window.

numerator.description: RATIO only: key of a SUM or LEVEL metric in this response.

denominator.description: RATIO only: key of a SUM or LEVEL metric in this response.

good.description: Which direction reads as good news.

funnelOrder.description: Places the metric as a stage of the in-app funnel, 1 first. Absent means not a funnel stage.

metric.description: A key from metrics; not a RATIO metric.

dimension.description: Null for the day's total. source:<name> or campaign:<id>:<name> for a breakdown row.

sampleSize.description: How many users or events the value rests on. Under 20 reads as insufficient data. Never a list of ids.
